sections.text: - Reduces the size and number of raindrops on the players' screen

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
- The glasses were distributed to viewers of the 14 Apr 2020 Twitch Rivals event via random loot drops.
- The glasses first appeared after the v0.12.4.6673 patch (08 Apr 2020) as a random drop from the Scav case. This was likely unintentional.
